title: Ten Ways to Travel More Responsibly in Tanzania
excerpt: Ten practical ways to make your trip to Tanzania more responsible, for nature, communities and the people who work in tourism.
body:
1. **Choose a local partner** that treats staff fairly.
2. **Stay longer** in fewer places, which means less driving and less fuel.
3. **Respect wildlife**: distance, no feeding, no off-road driving where not allowed.
4. **Use refillable bottles.**
5. **No plastic carrier bags.** See [the ban](/blog/tanzania-plastic-bag-ban/).
6. **Buy local** crafts directly from makers.
7. **Ask before photographing people.** See [photographing people](/blog/photographing-people-tanzania/).
8. **Tip fairly.** See [tipping](/blog/tipping-tanzania/).
9. **Choose responsible excursions**, such as [dolphin trips that keep distance](/blog/zanzibar-dolphins-responsibly/).
10. **Learn a few words of Swahili.** See [Swahili phrases](/blog/swahili-phrases-for-safari/).

Read our [responsible tourism page](/responsible-tourism-tanzania/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
